maria-chen: Quick follow-up to the model-vetting RFC. I think we should add a short "golden-config" verification stage between ingest and full bench. It'd run a small runtime smoke on a representative input, check KV/inference shapes, and a latency/QLAT sanity check. Thoughts?

samir: +1. The full bench is expensive and slow for many tiny model updates. Golden-config stage would catch obvious misbindings early. Question: what asserts do we need? shape, dtype, kv-cache warmup, and basic rerun determinism?

vincent: I'd add a minimal token-level perf check: median p50 latency under a per-model budget (configurable). Also validate quantization bitwidths and ops present (e.g., fused_attention kernel available). If any op falls back to generic kernels -> fail.

katie: FYI we have a lightweight harness in tools/smoke-runner that does shape/dtype checks already. It needs an adapter to map model metadata -> runtime flags. We could expose a small plugin API: validate(metadata) -> {ok, reasons}

alex: +1 to plugin API. Proposal for plugin signature:
```
def validate(metadata: Dict[str,str]) -> Tuple[bool, List[str]]:
    # quick checks: inputs, kv, supported ops
```
Would be easy to run in CI as well.

maria-chen: Concrete gate behavior question: do we FAIL fast (block ingest) or WARN and create a canary rollout? My preference: block on kernel/op/backcompat failures; WARN on perf flakiness and push to canary.

samir: agree. Block on correctness invariants. Perf can be soft-gated with a scoring and A/B rollout policy. Perf regression threshold should be per-customer and per-tier.

vincent: also discuss rollback semantics: if an onboarded model later fails in production checks, we need an automated choke that downgrades traffic to previous variant. That's an infra + routing change.

qa-bot: Automated check: smoke-runner v0.3 executed on model 'llama-lite-v2'
Results: shapes OK, dtype OK, kernel-check: fused_attention present, quant bits: int8 fallback on matmul -> WARN

katie: For the int8 fallback WARN, do we add a recommended remediation? Suggest we auto-suggest quantization profile: `recommend --model llama-lite-v2 --profile stable-int8` and link to docs: https://internal.redwood/quant-profiles

maria-chen: Next steps: I'll draft a small RFC update with plugin API and gate policy matrix. @samir @vincent can you sketch the perf budget templates? I'll include the suggested rollback routing hook.

samir: on it, will post a draft snippet tomorrow.

vincent: I'll prototype a kernel-check tool that parses runtime logs for kernel fallbacks and emits a machine-readable report.

alex: I'll wire the plugin API into the ingest CI job so it fails fast on correctness errors.

maria-chen: Thanks all :thumbsup: We'll sync in the RFC doc and try to avoid adding heavyweight bench runs to the critical path.
